# sculptura fee model: dynamic pricing and rates reference

snapshot of the live fee model as of 2026-10-12: every table (values,
formulas, inherited conditions) and the page inventory, for reference
when implementing the fee policy and the pricing service. the repo is
the source of truth; all inputs were ported from repo evidence and
every worked number was verified against local python math (verify.py)
before entry. companion documents: fee-policy.md (the policy design),
work/fee-balance-analysis.md (the rate balance and retro payback math),
work/research.md (the evidence register).

- Headcount: `actuals: sum(Headcount[`Employee ID` in any])`, `forecast: sum(Headcount[`Employee ID` in any])`
- Employee ID: `actuals: if(`Start date`$[`Employee ID` = this.`Employee ID`] <= eomonth(Date.Month, 0), 1, 0)`, `forecast: if(`Start date`$[`Employee ID` = this.`Employee ID`] <= eomonth(Date.Month, 0), 1, 0)`
- Employee payroll: `actuals: sum(`Employee payroll`[`Employee ID` in any])`, `forecast: sum(`Employee payroll`[`Employee ID` in any])`
- Employee ID: `actuals: Headcount * `Annual salary`$[`Employee ID` = this.`Employee ID`] / 12 * (1 + `Payroll burden`$)`, `forecast: Headcount * `Annual salary`$[`Employee ID` = this.`Employee ID`] / 12 * (1 + `Payroll burden`$)`
- Payroll by department: `actuals: sum(`Payroll by department`[Department in any])`, `forecast: sum(`Payroll by department`[Department in any])`
- Department: `actuals: sum(`Employee payroll`$[`Employee ID`.Department = this.Department, Date.Month = this.Date.Month])`, `forecast: sum(`Employee payroll`$[`Employee ID`.Department = this.Department, Date.Month = this.Date.Month])`

formulas:
- New creators: `actuals: sum(`New creators`[Market in any])`, `forecast: sum(`New creators`[Market in any])`
- Market: `actuals: iferror(if(Date.Month >= `Launch month`$[Market = this.Market], `New creators at launch`$[Market = this.Market] * (1 + `Creator signup growth`$[Market = this.Market]) ^ datedif(`Launch month`$[Market = this.Market], Date.Month, "M"), 0), 0)`, `forecast: iferror(if(Date.Month >= `Launch month`$[Market = this.Market], `New creators at launch`$[Market = this.Market] * (1 + `Creator signup growth`$[Market = this.Market]) ^ datedif(`Launch month`$[Market = this.Market], Date.Month, "M"), 0), 0)`
- Active creators: `actuals: sum(`Active creators`[Market in any])`, `forecast: sum(`Active creators`[Market in any])`
- Market: `actuals: `Active creators`[-1] * (1 - `Monthly creator churn`$[Market = this.Market]) + `New creators``, `forecast: `Active creators`[-1] * (1 - `Monthly creator churn`$[Market = this.Market]) + `New creators``
- Orders: `actuals: sum(Orders[Market in any])`, `forecast: sum(Orders[Market in any])`
- Market: `actuals: `Active creators` * `Orders per active creator`$[Market = this.Market]`, `forecast: `Active creators` * `Orders per active creator`$[Market = this.Market]`
- Gross merchandise value: `actuals: sum(`Gross merchandise value`[Market in any])`, `forecast: sum(`Gross merchandise value`[Market in any])`
- Market: `actuals: sum(`Gross merchandise value`[Metal in any])`, `forecast: sum(`Gross merchandise value`[Metal in any])`
- Metal: `actuals: Orders$[Market = this.Market, Date.Month = this.Date.Month] * `Order mix`$[Metal = this.Metal] * `Average order value`$[Metal = this.Metal]`, `forecast: Orders$[Market = this.Market, Date.Month = this.Date.Month] * `Order mix`$[Metal = this.Metal] * `Average order value`$[Metal = this.Metal]`
